fichas.title: Entrance hall
fichas.summary: The entrance hall should provide adequate space for greeting, moving around, taking off and putting on coats, and orienting visitors. Where the entrance opens directly outdoors, an inner door can provide a wind-lobby function. Arrange belongings practically and tidily, and provide direct access to important shared areas such as the kitchen, WC, and stairs.
furniture_equipment: Storage for coats, jackets, umbrellas, hats, briefcases, and shoes
